none: PAS CAM-072122: Roman Coin : A copper-alloy nummus of Gratian
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [D N GRATIANVS AVGG AVG] ; R/ GLORIA NOVI SAECVLI

A copper-alloy nummus of Gratian, 367-383. Mint is Arles, 367-375, Reece period 19. Obverse shows Pearl-diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Obverse legend reads [D N GRATIANVS AVGG AVG]. Reverse shows Emperor standing, holding standard and shield. Reverse legend reads GLORIA NOVI SAECVLI. Reverse fields and exergue read: / //[...]. Condition is fair, die axis is 6 o'clock, weight is 1.82g,…
